purpose: Ceiling on LLM-visible MCP tool calls for the DEFAULT path. Measured 2026-09: tools were 13% of agent wall time, the driving LLM's turns 87%; a clean booking took 9 mediated calls (native tools about 5). Any number below changes only with a CE id in changed_by, and that CE's call_budget must record the same number (test_budget.py checks both).

canvas_regions.description: no AX controls; Perception text regions, one chooser call, capture-bound click

large_page_400.description: 80 records, 400+ elements: response must stay small
